scenarios.title: Abilities that triggered in the untap step wait and go on the stack with the upkeep triggers before the active player gets priority

setup.notes: Mesmeric Orb: whenever a permanent becomes untapped, that permanent's controller mills a card. Mountain is tapped at the start of the untap step.

decisions: The untap step begins; A untaps Mountain, which triggers Mesmeric Orb; no player receives priority in the untap step.
The upkeep step begins; Juzám Djinn's trigger happens.

Both pending triggers are put on the stack, A putting Mesmeric Orb's trigger on first and Juzám Djinn's on top; then A receives priority and the stack is observed. Both players then pass until the stack is empty.

variants.label: untap_trigger
variants.expected: When A first receives priority in the upkeep step the stack holds two triggered abilities, Mesmeric Orb's mill and Juzám Djinn's damage; none has resolved yet (library still 5 cards, A's life 20). After they resolve A's library is 4 cards and A's life is 19.

variants.label: nothing_untaps
variants.delta: Mountain is untapped at the start of the untap step, so nothing untaps.
variants.expected: When A first receives priority in the upkeep step the stack holds only Juzám Djinn's trigger; A's library stays at 5 cards and, after it resolves, A's life is 19.

detector.outcome: A trigger with Mode$ Untaps is evaluated against a permanent becoming untapped and fires; one that fires in the untap step is held until the upkeep step, where it goes on the stack before the active player gets priority.
detector.near_miss: An Untaps trigger evaluated against an untapping permanent its condition does not match, which does not fire.

scenarios.title: A spell castable only after a player's upkeep step becomes castable after the first of several upkeep steps ends

setup.notes: It is B's turn. Paradox Haze is an Aura on player B: at the beginning of B's first upkeep each turn, B gets an additional upkeep step after this step. Reset: cast only during an opponent's turn after their upkeep step; untap all lands you control. The Haze trigger resolves in the first upkeep step.

decisions: B's first upkeep begins and Paradox Haze's trigger resolves; B's first upkeep step ends only when both players pass with an empty stack.
A casts Reset, tapping two untapped Islands, in B's additional upkeep step, after the first upkeep step has ended; both players pass and it resolves.

variants.label: second_upkeep
variants.expected: Casting Reset is legal (can_play true); it resolves and all three of A's Islands are untapped.

variants.label: first_upkeep
variants.delta: A attempts it in B's first upkeep step, after Paradox Haze's trigger resolved and before that step ends.
variants.expected: Casting Reset is not legal (can_play false): B's first upkeep step has not ended.

operation.unclassifiable: Changes which upkeep step of the turn is observed.

scenarios.forge_notes: Reset uses CheckSVar$ Count$FinishedUpkeepsThisTurn; check Forge counts the first upkeep as finished once the additional upkeep begins.

detector.outcome: A candidate restricted to being cast after a player's upkeep step has finished (a CheckSVar$ count of finished upkeeps) passes its script_condition check once that upkeep step has ended.
detector.near_miss: The same kind of candidate fails its script_condition check while the upkeep step has not yet ended.
